asset.name: Command Registry
asset.description: The dynamic registry of commands with labels, shortcuts, grouping, visibility rules, availability predicates, and async execution, shared by palettes, menus, and toolbars.

requires.reason: Registrations are scoped so a nested surface can contribute commands without leaking them.

suggests.reason: Only applications that bind commands to keys need collision resolution, and it brings platform-specific labelling with it.
